projectDescription: CoTel is an AI copilot for Telegram that lets you analyze chats, channels, and groups with AI — summarizing conversations, extracting keywords, searching content, and setting up automated subscriptions with Telegram notifications.
keyFeatures: Full-text semantic search across chat content
Automated subscriptions with periodic AI analysis and Telegram notifications
QR code and phone number Telegram authentication
Export results to PDF and other formats
Analysis history with repeat and export actions
Choice of AI model (OpenAI GPT-4.1 mini or Claude Sonnet)
publicApiSurface: POST /analyze — run AI analysis on a Telegram chat or channel
GET /auth/me — get current user profile and plan
POST /account/change-plan — switch subscription plan (free / basic / pro)
GET/POST /subscriptions — list, create, manage automated subscriptions
